name: vision-1.0.0
description: AI camera vision via Home Assistant LLM Vision + Frigate NVR — analyze feeds, query events, get snapshots

tools.name: vision
tools.description: Camera vision and NVR control. LLM Vision actions (AI analysis via GPT-4o/Claude/Gemini): 'analyze_camera' (see what's on a camera), 'analyze_video_event' (analyze Frigate event clip), 'watch_stream' (monitor live feed for duration). Frigate NVR actions (direct camera access): 'get_snapshot' (current frame as base64 JPEG), 'get_events' (recent detections — person, car, etc.), 'get_thumbnail' (event thumbnail image), 'list_cameras' (available cameras + status), 'camera_status' (single camera detail).

action.description: What to do — see description for full list

camera_name.description: Camera entity name (e.g. 'garage', 'front_door'). Auto-prefixes camera. for HA.

prompt.description: What to look for or analyze (for AI analysis actions)

provider.description: Vision provider: 'openai' (GPT-4o), 'anthropic' (Claude), 'google' (Gemini). Default: HA configured default.

duration.description: Seconds to watch stream (1-60, default: 10). For watch_stream.

label.description: Detection type filter: person, car, dog, cat, package, etc. (for get_events)

hours_back.description: How far back to search events (default: 4)

env.name: HOME_ASSISTANT_URL
env.description: Home Assistant base URL (e.g. http://homeassistant.local:8123). Required for LLM Vision actions.

env.name: HOME_ASSISTANT_TOKEN
env.description: Home Assistant long-lived access token. Required for LLM Vision actions.

env.name: FRIGATE_URL
env.description: Frigate NVR base URL (e.g. http://frigate:5000). Required for Frigate actions.
